selection.rationale: Strong implementation-level control-plane pattern: enforce capabilities outside a long-running agent, protect credentials, and verify policy independently of the model.
Distinct verification architecture for multi-tool MCP agents: preserve claim-to-source identity instead of allowing pooled evidence to hide attribution errors.
Concrete adoption pattern for small teams: pair real workflow examples with hands-on local coaching, follow-up, and outcome assessment.
Publisher-reported production workflow with measurable operational changes, human escalation, and an explicit feedback loop for improving the agent.
Best current reusable Agent Skills evidence: repeated instructions become maintained, portable task procedures rather than one-off prompts.
Clear nontechnical operating model for AI teammates: named roles, visible work, scoped permissions, shared memory, and separate governance authority.

excluded_reviewed.reason: Strong infrastructure launch but less directly actionable for the Brief's engineering audience than runtime control and source-aware verification; retained as reviewed alternate.
Useful public-sector workflow story, but the selected OpenAI and Anthropic sales items provide broader knowledge-worker operating lessons; retained as reviewed alternate.
Strong contract-agent reference architecture, but Asana adds a more general nontechnical governance pattern while Google fills the one required Agent Skills slot; retained as reviewed alternate.
